feature: Sync choice polish: the comparing step as the loading screen, and the three choice cards at one height (lane 7e, Hugh's production test of Collection Sync, 2026-10-15). Uses existing components only.
note: Needs COLLECTION_EDIT_ENABLED=true and COLLECTION_SYNC_ENABLED=true, and an account whose newest confirmed upload with no ledger entry is the Sync base (the Sync card is unavailable without one). SYNC_PASTE is a short card list, one `N Name` per line. The comparing step is a transient read and is not a row: it is photographed by holding the server actions (see the PR).

rows.label: /collection/replace: the choice, Replace, Add these cards and Sync my collection at one height on desktop, stacked on the phone
